ESV.1: “These are the names of the tribes: Beginning at the northern extreme, beside the way of Hethlon to Lebo-hamath, as far as Hazar-enan (which is on the northern border of Damascus over against Hamath), and extending  from the east side to the west,  Dan, one portion.
ESV.2: Adjoining the territory of Dan, from the east side to the west, Asher, one portion.
ESV.3: Adjoining the territory of Asher, from the east side to the west, Naphtali, one portion.
ESV.4: Adjoining the territory of Naphtali, from the east side to the west, Manasseh, one portion.
ESV.5: Adjoining the territory of Manasseh, from the east side to the west, Ephraim, one portion.
ESV.6: Adjoining the territory of Ephraim, from the east side to the west, Reuben, one portion.
ESV.7: Adjoining the territory of Reuben, from the east side to the west, Judah, one portion.
ESV.8: “Adjoining the territory of Judah, from the east side to the west, shall be the portion which you shall set apart, 25,000 cubits  in breadth, and in length equal to one of the tribal portions, from the east side to the west, with the sanctuary in the midst of it.
ESV.9: The portion that you shall set apart for the LORD shall be 25,000 cubits in length, and 20,000  in breadth.
ESV.10: These shall be the allotments of the holy portion: the priests shall have an allotment measuring 25,000 cubits on the northern side, 10,000 cubits in breadth on the western side, 10,000 in breadth on the eastern side, and 25,000 in length on the southern side, with the sanctuary of the LORD in the midst of it.
ESV.11: This shall be for the consecrated priests, the sons of Zadok, who kept my charge, who did not go astray when the people of Israel went astray, as the Levites did.
ESV.12: And it shall belong to them as a special portion from the holy portion of the land, a most holy place, adjoining the territory of the Levites.
ESV.13: And alongside the territory of the priests, the Levites shall have an allotment 25,000 cubits in length and 10,000 in breadth. The whole length shall be 25,000 cubits and the breadth 20,000.
ESV.14: They shall not sell or exchange any of it. They shall not alienate this choice portion of the land, for it is holy to the LORD.
ESV.15: “The remainder, 5,000 cubits in breadth and 25,000 in length, shall be for common use for the city, for dwellings and for open country. In the midst of it shall be the city,
ESV.16: and these shall be its measurements: the north side 4,500 cubits, the south side 4,500, the east side 4,500, and the west side 4,500.
ESV.17: And the city shall have open land: on the north 250 cubits, on the south 250, on the east 250, and on the west 250.
ESV.18: The remainder of the length alongside the holy portion shall be 10,000 cubits to the east, and 10,000 to the west, and it shall be alongside the holy portion. Its produce shall be food for the workers of the city.
ESV.19: And the workers of the city, from all the tribes of Israel, shall till it.
ESV.20: The whole portion that you shall set apart shall be 25,000 cubits square, that is, the holy portion together with the property of the city.
ESV.21: “What remains on both sides of the holy portion and of the property of the city shall belong to the prince. Extending from the 25,000 cubits of the holy portion to the east border, and westward from the 25,000 cubits to the west border, parallel to the tribal portions, it shall belong to the prince. The holy portion with the sanctuary of the temple shall be in its midst.
ESV.22: It shall be separate from the property of the Levites and the property of the city, which are in the midst of that which belongs to the prince. The portion of the prince shall lie between the territory of Judah and the territory of Benjamin.
ESV.23: “As for the rest of the tribes: from the east side to the west, Benjamin, one portion.
ESV.24: Adjoining the territory of Benjamin, from the east side to the west, Simeon, one portion.
ESV.25: Adjoining the territory of Simeon, from the east side to the west, Issachar, one portion.
ESV.26: Adjoining the territory of Issachar, from the east side to the west, Zebulun, one portion.
ESV.27: Adjoining the territory of Zebulun, from the east side to the west, Gad, one portion.
ESV.28: And adjoining the territory of Gad to the south, the boundary shall run from Tamar to the waters of Meribah-kadesh, from there along the Brook of Egypt  to the Great Sea.
ESV.29: This is the land that you shall allot as an inheritance among the tribes of Israel, and these are their portions, declares the Lord GOD.
ESV.30: “These shall be the exits of the city: On the north side, which is to be 4,500 cubits by measure,
ESV.31: three gates, the gate of Reuben, the gate of Judah, and the gate of Levi, the gates of the city being named after the tribes of Israel.
ESV.32: On the east side, which is to be 4,500 cubits, three gates, the gate of Joseph, the gate of Benjamin, and the gate of Dan.
ESV.33: On the south side, which is to be 4,500 cubits by measure, three gates, the gate of Simeon, the gate of Issachar, and the gate of Zebulun.
ESV.34: On the west side, which is to be 4,500 cubits, three gates,  the gate of Gad, the gate of Asher, and the gate of Naphtali.
ESV.35: The circumference of the city shall be 18,000 cubits. And the name of the city from that time on shall be, The LORD Is There.”

NLT.2: “Asher’s territory lies south of Dan’s and also extends from east to west.
NLT.3: Naphtali’s land lies south of Asher’s, also extending from east to west.

NLT.7: and then Judah, all of whose boundaries extend from east to west.

NLT.11: This area is set aside for the ordained priests, the descendants of Zadok who served me faithfully and did not go astray with the people of Israel and the rest of the Levites.

CSB17.29: This is the land you are to allot as an inheritance to Israel’s tribes, <sup>ⓙ</sup> and these will be their portions.” This is the declaration of the Lord GOD.
CSB17.30: “These are the exits of the city: On the north side, which measures 1½ miles,

CSB17.34: On the west side, which is 1½ miles, there will be three gates: one, the gate of Gad; one, the gate of Asher; and one, the gate of Naphtali.

NIV.1:
The Division of the Land
“These are the tribes, listed by name: At the northern frontier, Dan will have one portion; it will follow the Hethlon road to Lebo Hamath; Hazar Enan and the northern border of Damascus next to Hamath will be part of its border from the east side to the west side.
NIV.2: “Asher will have one portion; it will border the territory of Dan from east to west.
NIV.3: “Naphtali will have one portion; it will border the territory of Asher from east to west.
NIV.4: “Manasseh will have one portion; it will border the territory of Naphtali from east to west.
NIV.5: “Ephraim will have one portion; it will border the territory of Manasseh from east to west.
NIV.6: “Reuben will have one portion; it will border the territory of Ephraim from east to west.
NIV.7: “Judah will have one portion; it will border the territory of Reuben from east to west.
NIV.8: “Bordering the territory of Judah from east to west will be the portion you are to present as a special gift. It will be 25,000 cubits wide, and its length from east to west will equal one of the tribal portions; the sanctuary will be in the center of it.
NIV.9: “The special portion you are to offer to the Lord will be 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide.
NIV.10: This will be the sacred portion for the priests. It will be 25,000 cubits long on the north side, 10,000 cubits wide on the west side, 10,000 cubits wide on the east side and 25,000 cubits long on the south side. In the center of it will be the sanctuary of the Lord.
NIV.11: This will be for the consecrated priests, the Zadokites, who were faithful in serving me and did not go astray as the Levites did when the Israelites went astray.
NIV.12: It will be a special gift to them from the sacred portion of the land, a most holy portion, bordering the territory of the Levites.
NIV.13: “Alongside the territory of the priests, the Levites will have an allotment 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide. Its total length will be 25,000 cubits and its width 10,000 cubits.
NIV.14: They must not sell or exchange any of it. This is the best of the land and must not pass into other hands, because it is holy to the Lord.
NIV.15: “The remaining area, 5,000 cubits wide and 25,000 cubits long, will be for the common use of the city, for houses and for pastureland. The city will be in the center of it
NIV.16: and will have these measurements: the north side 4,500 cubits, the south side 4,500 cubits, the east side 4,500 cubits, and the west side 4,500 cubits.
NIV.17: The pastureland for the city will be 250 cubits on the north, 250 cubits on the south, 250 cubits on the east, and 250 cubits on the west.
NIV.18: What remains of the area, bordering on the sacred portion and running the length of it, will be 10,000 cubits on the east side and 10,000 cubits on the west side. Its produce will supply food for the workers of the city.
NIV.19: The workers from the city who farm it will come from all the tribes of Israel.
NIV.20: The entire portion will be a square, 25,000 cubits on each side. As a special gift you will set aside the sacred portion, along with the property of the city.
NIV.21: “What remains on both sides of the area formed by the sacred portion and the city property will belong to the prince. It will extend eastward from the 25,000 cubits of the sacred portion to the eastern border, and westward from the 25,000 cubits to the western border. Both these areas running the length of the tribal portions will belong to the prince, and the sacred portion with the temple sanctuary will be in the center of them.
NIV.22: So the property of the Levites and the property of the city will lie in the center of the area that belongs to the prince. The area belonging to the prince will lie between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin.
NIV.23: “As for the rest of the tribes: Benjamin will have one portion; it will extend from the east side to the west side.
NIV.24: “Simeon will have one portion; it will border the territory of Benjamin from east to west.
NIV.25: “Issachar will have one portion; it will border the territory of Simeon from east to west.
NIV.26: “Zebulun will have one portion; it will border the territory of Issachar from east to west.
NIV.27: “Gad will have one portion; it will border the territory of Zebulun from east to west.
NIV.28: “The southern boundary of Gad will run south from Tamar to the waters of Meribah Kadesh, then along the Wadi of Egypt to the Great Sea.
NIV.29: “This is the land you are to allot as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel, and these will be their portions,” declares the Sovereign Lord.
NIV.30:
The Gates of the City
“These will be the exits of the city: Beginning on the north side, which is 4,500 cubits long,
NIV.31: the gates of the city will be named after the tribes of Israel. The three gates on the north side will be the gate of Reuben, the gate of Judah and the gate of Levi.
NIV.32: “On the east side, which is 4,500 cubits long, will be three gates: the gate of Joseph, the gate of Benjamin and the gate of Dan.
NIV.33: “On the south side, which measures 4,500 cubits, will be three gates: the gate of Simeon, the gate of Issachar and the gate of Zebulun.
NIV.34: “On the west side, which is 4,500 cubits long, will be three gates: the gate of Gad, the gate of Asher and the gate of Naphtali.
NIV.35:
“The distance all around will be 18,000 cubits.
“And the name of the city from that time on will be:
the Lord is there.”
